cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,re
lines=open("ob_accounts.txt").read().splitlines()
for idx in [7,8,9]:  # baris 8,9,10
    l=lines[idx-1]
    parts=[p.strip() for p in l.split("|")]
    aid=parts[0]; key=parts[1]
    if not key.startswith("sk-obs1"): 
        print(f"baris {idx}: id={aid} key tidak ada"); continue
    try:
        r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/get_user_balance",headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {key}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30) as x:
            print(f"baris {idx}: id={aid} saldo={json.load(x)['balance']} key={key[:28]}...")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(f"baris {idx}: id={aid} HTTP{e.code} key={key[:28]}...")
